summary: CliRunner terminates with io.UnsupportedOperation when using faulthandler.
issue_text: The output redirection for CliRunner doesn't play nicely with Python's faulthandler library. When faulthandler.enable() is called within a Click command invoked by CliRunner(catch_exceptions=False), it terminates prematurely with io.UnsupportedOperation: fileno. On Click 8.3.3 and later, CliRunner exposes the underlying fileno so faulthandler succeeds.
traceback_excerpt: click/testing.py, in invoke: return_value = cli.main(); io.UnsupportedOperation: fileno
